Frequently asked questions Everything you need to know about SendX and our services. Last updated June 2026. What is SendX? SendX is email marketing software that helps businesses send, automate, and track email campaigns. It uses an AI-powered sending engine to maintain 95–98% inbox placement rates across Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and Apple Mail. Trusted by 3,000+ businesses to deliver over 4.4 billion emails, with unlimited sends on every plan starting at $9.99/month. Can I send unlimited emails? Yes, absolutely. All our paid plans come with unlimited email sends. We base our pricing on the number of subscribers you have, not how many emails you send. This gives you the freedom to engage with your audience as often as you need to without worrying about hitting a limit or incurring extra charges. How does SendX pricing work? SendX pricing starts at $9.99/month for up to 1,000 subscribers. All plans include unlimited email sends, every feature, and 24/7 live support. Pricing scales only with subscriber count — no per-email fees, no feature tiers, and no hidden charges. Do you offer a free trial? Yes, we do! You can sign up for a 14-day free trial to experience SendX with full access to all our features. No credit card is required to get started, so you can explore everything we have to offer, risk-free. Can I import my existing email lists into SendX? Yes, importing your contacts is easy. You can upload a CSV file with your subscriber lists, and our system will securely import them. We also help ensure a smooth transition by guiding you through the process of warming up your sending domain to maintain high deliverability. How easy is it to switch to SendX from another service? Switching to SendX typically takes less than a day. You import contacts via CSV, and our 24/7 support team guides the migration and deliverability warmup — so inbox placement rates stay at 95–98% from day one. Most customers migrate from Mailchimp, ActiveCampaign, or Klaviyo without any drop in engagement. What kind of customer support can I expect? We pride ourselves on offering exceptional customer support. Every SendX user, regardless of their plan size, gets access to our 24/7 support team via email and live chat. Our mission is to help you succeed, and we're always here to answer your questions and provide assistance whenever you need it. What happens if I go over my subscriber limit? Your service will continue without any interruption. If your subscriber count exceeds your current plan's limit, your account will be automatically and seamlessly upgraded to the next pricing tier. This ensures you can keep growing your list and sending campaigns without any downtime or manual intervention. Still have questions? We're here to help.
